Are you a contracts expert who wants to work on the largest defence project in WA?   Your new company     Hays is currently recruiting a Senior Commercial Advisor for the Australian Submarine Company who has been selected to deliver a $12B defence project in Henderson, WA.    If you have 6+ years experience in Commercial Advisory on heavy engineering or defence projects, this could be for you.   Please note that this role requires a security clearance. Security clearances can only be granted to Australian citizens. For more information, please visit: https://www.agsva.gov.au/   Your new role     The Senior Commercial Advisor will support the Commercial team in providing contract and commercial advice, guidance and capability to the Nuclear Submarine Sustainment Programme, the largest and most complex industrial undertaking in Australia's history.    
 
 Provide contractual and commercial advice and guidance    
 Prepare commercial related documents for submission to the client   
 Support the programme to navigate complex contract management    
 Draft and negotiate contracts with head contractors for licencing, leasing and training    
 Develop and manage contract change proposals    
 Advice on supply chain and supporting    
 Analyse commercial amendments and implications   
 Review contract renewals    
 Negotiation   
 Commercial advice on subcontractor compliance to the head contractor    
 Delivery of the contractual obligations    
 Resolution of issues and will require an ability to simply communicate complex issues.   
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Please note that this role requires a security clearance. Security clearances can only be granted to Australian citizens. For more information, please visit: https://www.agsva.gov.au/ 
 At least 6 years experience in a similar position preparing contracts for heavy engineering or defence    
 Bachelors in law, engineering or similar studies 
 Ability to resolve commercial contractual issues 
 Develop and amend contractual terms and conditions 
 Financial confidence and attention to detail 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Be part of the largest project in defence in WA, with a 10-15 year project pipeline.   
 Huge career development commencing at the start of the project life cycle.   
 High possibility of permanency, initally a 12-month fixed-term contract ASC will mobilise to permanency sooner for the right candidate.    
 10 extra annual leave days, work-life balance, discounts, health benefits & more 
 
  What you need to do now     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
